measured.explanation: Fuel (coal) is consumed in whole items: each stone furnace burns one coal per fuel_value / energy_usage seconds and the consumption counter moves when a coal starts burning, so over the window every furnace counts a whole number of coal (phase 4b: the window is 6 x 60 s, about 8 coal per furnace, so the quantisation is about 1% instead of the 3% of the earlier 120 s window); no furnace ran out: the plate output meets the contract.

note: Flat test field. A 7.5 plates/s stone-furnace row at the site origin; iron ore and coal from two infinity-chest sources placed from their links (`site.build`: the cheapest estimated belt to the port they serve), side-loaded by the router onto the row's left (ore) and right (coal) lanes; plates into a counting sink; power from an energy-interface fixture.

note: Normal map (`config/ore-map-gen-settings.json`). Clear obstacles around the nearest iron patch -> snapshot -> one-belt mining unit (`site_sweep.choose_mining`: highest belt rate not above the smelting row's ore lane, each variant capped there with `max_belt_rate`, no drill dry within the window) -> smelting row sized to the belt's initial rate, placed from its links (`site.build`: cheapest estimated belt from the ore belt's end, off the ore), fixtures likewise -> router: ore belt side-loaded onto the row's left lane, coal fixture onto the right lane, plates to a sink, one power fixture chained to both units.
